<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="light">
  <title>Black circle</title>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
    body {
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: 100dvh;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      background: #fff;
    }
    svg {
      display: block;
      width: min(400px, 90vmin);
      height: auto;
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      overflow: visible; /* keep antialiased edge pixels from being clipped */
    }
    @media (forced-colors: active) {
      circle { fill: CanvasText; }
    }
  </style>
  <link rel="icon" href="data:,">
</head>
<body>
  <main>
    <svg width="400" height="400" viewBox="0 0 400 400" role="img" aria-labelledby="circle-title">
      <title id="circle-title">Black circle</title>
      <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="200" fill="#000"/>
    </svg>
  </main>
</body>
</html>

content.text:
I read through `0.html` and didn't change anything, because it's already in good shape:

- **Accessibility:** the SVG is labelled as an image with a title, and it has a fallback for high-contrast mode (`forced-colors`).
- **Layout:** it's centered and scales to fit the screen, with correct mobile viewport handling (`dvh`).
- **Page setup:** it has a proper doctype, language, character set and viewport, plus a blank favicon so browsers don't request one that doesn't exist.

One small thing: `overflow: visible` on the SVG does very little and could be removed. It isn't worth changing on its own.

What kind of improvement do you have in mind? For example:
1. **Visual:** a gradient or shading, a shadow, or dark-mode support.
2. **Interactive:** hover or click effects, or animation that respects the user's reduced-motion setting.
3. **Structural:** making size and color adjustable settings, or turning it into a reusable component.

Tell me which one (or something else) and I'll make the change.
